body.message:
Please note that if you wish to proceed with the booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and refundable security deposit must be paid in advance. Once these payments are received, we will be able to block and secure the unit for you.

The remaining months can be paid on a monthly basis as agreed. Please also note that the rate is all-inclusive; however, daily housekeeping is not included.

If you require additional cleaning during your stay, we can arrange this upon request at an additional charge per cleaning service.
